rationale: With only 2 minutes remaining in the session, there is insufficient time to capture any meaningful directional move — the ATR of $0.14 per 5-minute candle provides a maximum expected move far too small to overcome the 24.2 bps spread cost and execution slippage. The stock has already sold off sharply from its $18.44 high to $16.55 with downward momentum on the last few candles, but entering a short at close with no ability to manage the position overnight on a +34% gap stock carries unacceptable gap-risk. No edge justifies a trade at this point in the session.
